BOARD OF EXAMINERS, APPEALS AND
  CONDEMNATION AGENDA
  MONDAY, JULY 21, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 4TH FLOOR, 1:30 PM

Janet Lipson, Chair  Erin Hoops, Member
Steve Askin, Vice Chair  Joseph Hower, Member
Ismar Enriquez, Member  Ethel Powers, Member

Angel Arredondo, Code Enforcement Officer  Nicholas Masero, Deputy City Attorney
Myeesha Ayala, Secretary

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  LBCD@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55850  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Board of Examiners, Appeals and
  Condemnation meeting of Monday, May 19, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55298  Recommendation to conclude the hearing and determine that the subject property
  located at 1508 Orange Avenue, Long Beach, CA, 90805, meets the definition of a
  vacant lot as stated in the Long Beach Municipal Code 18.29.070(C), the appellant
  is the owner of the property and uphold the annual administering fee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55851  Recommendation to conclude the hearing, adopt the findings of the Building
  Official as the Board’s findings, determine that the 2-One Story Commercial
  Buildings located at 6020-6090 Long Beach Blvd, Long Beach CA, 90805 is
  substandard and a public nuisance, and order the owners to demolish or
  rehabilitate the structures as per Findings dated July 21, 2025 by August 21, 2025.
  Also, order the owners to maintain the structures in a safe, clean and secure
  manner until the demolition or rehabilitation is complete.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55852  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Triennial Code
  Adoption.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Board of Examiners, Appeals and Condemnation on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Myeesha Ayala, Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.
NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact the Code Enforcement Bureau at (562) 570-2633 by noon, the
day prior to the meeting.
